sasha: Quick async standup — small batch today, TL;DR: onboarded ceres-v2 candidate, saw eval regression on QA dev set, leaving notes + next steps.
sasha: What I did: ran full eval on ceres-v2-2026-03-17, updated promptset v3 -> v3.1, created PR #4123 for prompt normalization.
jon: Nice. Can you paste failing example IDs so I can repro locally?
sasha: sure, sample ids: 1842, 1847, 1890. Fail mode is hallucination on date extraction.
maria: I pulled 1847 — output anchors to wrong year. attaching snippet: ```
input: "When did the treaty signings happen?"
expected: "1901-07-12"
output: "2001-07-12"
```
kevin: thanks — looks like date parser tokenization shift after the prompt tweak. Might be tokenization boundary with the date template.
sasha: blocker: need a quick patch to prompt normalization or revert to v3 for the QA route. I can ship revert today unless someone objects.
tara: +1 to revert for canary, then we iterate on prompt fixes in a separate PR. Avoid user-facing regressions.
jon: I'll run local smoke with kv cache warmup off/on to rule out KV behavior. command: `python -m eval.run --model ceres-v2 --split dev --ids 1842,1847,1890 --kv_warmup off`
eval-bot: evaluation summary (6187654350): ceres-v2 @canary -> QA F1 dropped 2.9 pts, BLEU -3.1, latency unchanged. Top diff: promptset v3.1 vs v3.
maria: I started a small promptset diff: `diff_prompts.py --old v3 --new v3.1 --sample 500`. Early hits show extra guiding sentence added that may bias year tokens.
kevin: I'll open quick PR to strip that sentence in the QA-only prompt. tag: `fix/qa-prompt-strip-190`
sasha: FYI I also queued a canary rollback for the QA model route at 15:30 PT if we don't have a patch by then.
tara: Heads-up for oncall: if rollback triggers alerts, please slack #eng-oncall and add incident template.
jon: code review ping on #4123 incoming — I'll leave comments inline.
sasha: today: revert canary if needed, land the strip PR, run nightly full-run. If rollback happens I'll post status here.
maria: I can help run the post-rollback smoke and collect traces. ping me when done.
kevin: ETA on PR ~1.5h, will loop back.
sasha: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
